title: Employ staff under the Australian Government Industry Award 2016
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Australian Government Industry Award 2016.

sources.title: Australian Government Industry Award 2016
sources.quote: 3.2 Coverage (a) This award covers the Australian Government industry. (b) Subject to clauses 3.3 to 3.5 , this modern award covers an employer in the Australian Government industry in relation to its employees to the exclusion of any other modern award.

sources.title: Australian Government Industry Award 2016
sources.quote: 3.1 Definitions Australian Government industry means all activities undertaken by bodies established by the Commonwealth for a public purpose.

sources.title: Australian Government Industry Award 2016
sources.quote: 3.2 Coverage (a) This award covers the Australian Government industry. (b) Subject to clauses 3.3 to 3.5 , this modern award covers an employer in the Australian Government industry in relation to its employees to the exclusion of any other modern award.

confidence_note: Bodies established by the Commonwealth for a public purpose (cl 3.1); the award's coverage is in clause 3, not clause 4.

assessment.summary: The Australian Government Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.

assessment.confidence_note: Economic reasoning and desk research only; no evaluation of this requirement found. Drafted 12 Nov 2026 from the award's coverage clause, not yet checked.
